ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Труд» (trud, 'labor') is 'labor' throughout and «работа» (rabota, 'work') 'work'; in passage 6 «возведение труда в достоинство» (vozvedenie truda v dostoinstvo) is 'the elevation of labor into a merit', with «питание» (pitanie, 'nourishment') rendered 'eating'. The attribution is 'Carlyle.' as printed, not the website draft's 'Thomas Carlyle', and Carlyle's «самоотчаяние» (samootchayanie, 'self-despair') keeps its compound.
